title: Palschema doesn't seem to load at all
body:
While i'm uncertain if this is a mod conflict or an issue with palschema, the mod and anything involved with it does not seem to be registered by the game and no mods using it seem to load at all... tried multiple re-installs and i'm near my wits end for what could be the problem...

Unsure of exactly what files are needed to help identify the cause... as far as i'm aware, the issue is palschema itself not loading since every pak and script mod work fine.
author: Ravenous212

comments.body: Hi, are you able to provide your `UE4SS.log` file? It's called either `UE4SS.log` or `UE4SS` if you have extensions disabled and it's located in the `ue4ss` folder where you installed UE4SS.

Sorry, forgot to update this; i've already managed to fix the issue... for some reason there was a duplicate mods folder in the Win64 folder, causing palschema to refuse to load and anything related to it
